title: Autoregressive or diffusion?
intro: Sort each trait by the generation paradigm it describes.

cards.text: Builds the output sequentially, predicting the next token
The transformer recipe that LLMs made famous
Strongest at instruction following and compositional accuracy
Starts from noise and refines the whole output each pass
A denoising network working in latent space
Strongest at high-fidelity detail, rich texture, coherence
Mental model: a sculptor carving finer detail with every pass

debrief: Autoregressive = sequential prediction (the LLM recipe): its strengths are control — following instructions, getting composition right. Diffusion = iterative denoising of the whole output in latent space: its strengths are fidelity — texture, detail, coherence. The strongest real systems are hybrids: autoregressive for global structure feeding diffusion for finish. When something misbehaves, name the paradigm whose strength is missing — that's where to look for a fix.
